subject: Post-signature MAP: warm-launch orchestration & canary windows — NovusHealth
messages:
From: Melissa Tran <melissa.tran@novushealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff + MAP details for warm launch (post-signature)

Connor, thanks — NovusHealth has signed and procurement completed earlier this week. We want to align on a compact, low-risk warm launch path embedded in the MAP: a canary to 5–10% traffic, an evaluation window (prompt/latency/accuracy checks), then a progressive migration to full traffic across two weeks.

Key asks from our side:
- A runnable MAP (owners, dates, rollback gates) we can review by EOD tomorrow.
- A short evaluation plan that includes sample prompt sets and acceptance metrics.
- Training dates for the Novus support & ops teams (2 x 90m sessions max).

I'll loop in Rajiv (ops) separately with preferred blackout windows — currently the week of Jun 14 is high-risk for us.

Thanks,
Melissa Tran
Director of Clinical Ops | NovusHealth
[Attachment: signed-sow-novus.pdf (pdf)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Melissa Tran <melissa.tran@novushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff + MAP details for warm launch (post-signature)

Melissa — congrats on the signed SOW. Attached is a first-draft warm-launch MAP and canary evaluation artifacts. High level:

- Kickoff call: Jun 7, 10:00 PT (30m) — confirm attendees.
- Canary window (phase 1): Jun 15–17 — 5% production traffic, 48-hour hold for evaluation gates.
- Ramp to 25% (phase 2): Jun 18–21 — performance & error gates at 24 and 48 hours.
- Full migration target: Jun 25 (conditional on gates).

Acceptance gates (examples in attached eval promptset):
- Latency P95 < 350ms for gen requests in canary window.
- Incorrect/unsafe output rate < 0.5% on curated promptset.
- No more than 2 priority incidents in 72-hour window.

Training: two 90-minute sessions — Jun 9 (ops orientation) and Jun 11 (support triage + prompts). We'll provide a recording and runbook.

Attachments included: novus-warm-launch-map-v1.xlsx (MAP + owner matrix), canary-eval-promptset-v1.json (sample prompts + scorecards), migration-checklist-v1.pdf (ops checklist).

If Jun 14 is a blackout for you, we'll avoid any ramping that week — we can shift dates accordingly.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: novus-warm-launch-map-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Quick clarifying questions on MAP:
- Migration window: are we planning DB cutover or is this purely request-routing (traffic split)? I want to ensure the migration-checklist aligns with Novus infra.
- Evaluation runbook: who on Novus side will own the prompt-set accuracy review (triaged by level: product vs clinical)?

I'll propose a brief internal ops readout tomorrow to finalize the checklist items.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: Melissa Tran <melissa.tran@novushealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff + MAP details for warm launch (post-signature)

Ben — thanks. To confirm: Novus will not do a DB cutover; this is a traffic-splitting rollout to our edge proxy. Novus ops (Rajiv Singh) will own live traffic metrics and incident triage. Clinical QA (me + 2 SMEs) will own accuracy/clinical-safety checks and triage false positives.

I'll add Rajiv to the thread after this note and share our internal blackout calendar (we cannot do any production code divergence Jun 14–18). Procurement also uploaded the signed SOW and a short deployment acceptance form to the Doc we shared: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/shared/novus/warm-launch-guide

Melissa
Director of Clinical Ops | NovusHealth
[Attachment: procurement-deposit-receipt.pdf (pdf)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Melissa Tran <melissa.tran@novushealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff + MAP details for warm launch (post-signature)

Folks — thanks for the quick alignment. Action items consolidated below (I'll update the MAP spreadsheet and re-share by Monday EOD):

1) Connor: finalize MAP dates accounting for Novus blackout (target: move canary to Jun 21–23, ramp Jun 24–27, full Jun 30).
2) Laura: confirm infra readiness checklist and run the internal smoke test on Jun 18 (owner: Laura).
3) Ben: schedule two training sessions (Jun 9 & Jun 11) and share calendar invites; capture attendee list.
4) Melissa & Rajiv: confirm ownership for evaluation gates and provide preferred alerting thresholds (by Jun 6).
5) Marissa: prepare rollback playbook and validation checklist; include quick rollback timeline (15–60m) and key ops contacts.

Evaluation plan highlights (from attachment):
- Prompt-set A (50 curated clinical scenarios) for accuracy check; results uploaded to shared sheet.
- Telemetry: token-level latency, error rates, confidence signals.
- Acceptance: passing run requires meeting all gates for 48 hours during canary.

I'll hold the kickoff on Jun 7 at 10:00 PT — invite to follow. If Novus confirms the blackout window, I will shift dates and ping the list.

Regards,
Connor O'Brien
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: migration-checklist-v1.pdf (pdf); canary-eval-promptset-v1.json (text)]
